Direct greedy replay through 256 symbols and independent recurrence/occurrence checks agree with the theorem.

value.rationale: The result exposes a sharp algorithmic/combinatorial separation inside the primary source’s flagship automatic example: every nontrivial period-doubling prefix has an optimal attractor of size two, yet the exact greedy construction introduced in the same paper grows as 1+floor(log_2 N). This makes the paper’s general logarithmic greedy bound tight on a linearly recurrent word with constant optimum and quantifies an unbounded approximation ratio, a structurally meaningful behavior rather than an arbitrary finite statistic.
